plugins.name: australian-accounting-skills
plugins.description: Workflow skills for Australian public-practice accounting: BAS preparation, month-end close, workpaper tie-out, FBT year-end, Division 7A, STP finalisation, year-end workpapers, Xero exports and 13-week cashflow. Each skill encodes the process and the tie-outs, and sends the agent to ato.gov.au for rates and thresholds that change yearly.
